cloud_services: Azure Resource Manager | Azure Storage | Microsoft 365
analyst_assessment: Multiple cloud identity, Conditional Access, privileged-access, and resource artifacts converge on the same authenticated session. The evidence supports a suspected cloud identity compromise investigation and containment response. The available telemetry does not independently prove credential theft, MFA bypass, data exfiltration, successful VM compromise, or persistence.
